headline: Chile’s CSAV posts $290.8 million Q3 profit on strong Hapag-Lloyd earnings
summary: Chilean shipping line Vapores Sucre (CSAV) reported a third-quarter net profit of $290.8 million, reversing first-half losses due to surging container rates at its affiliate Hapag-Lloyd.
why: CSAV is a major Latin American maritime holding company possessing a controlling equity stake in German container carrier Hapag-Lloyd.

impacts.why: Quarterly net profit rose to $290.8 million, reversing earlier 2026 losses.
